The paper gives a necessary-and-sufficient categorical full-law identification condition in colluder models, supporting the proposal's rank/alphabet comparator rather than an existing partial-audit endpoint criterion.
The paper distinguishes target-law from full-law identification and states that target-law recovery can persist when full-law identification fails.
